decks.notes: Mono White Control utilizes a variety of control cards and enchantments to establish board presence and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through Yorion, Sky Nomad's companion ability, as well as utilizing removal spells like Seal from Existence and Ossification. The enchantments such as Runed Halo, Authority of the Consuls, and The Restoration of Eiganjo help to control the board and protect against threats. Elspeth, Storm Slayer serves as a win condition and Caretaker's Talent provides additional utility. The land base includes Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx for ramp and several utility lands for flexibility.

The deck focuses on combining Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy that allows for fast and explosive plays. It also includes support cards like Fatal Push and Sheltered by Ghosts to protect key pieces and control the board. The Mycosynth Gardens and Cryptcaller Chariot provide additional utility and resources for the combo to function smoothly. The inclusion of Seasoned Hallowblade and Monument to Endurance adds resilience and flexibility to the deck's overall strategy, making it a versatile and potent force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by recurring Arclight Phoenixes and casting cheap spells to trigger their abilities. The deck includes a mix of card draw, burn spells, and utility lands to maintain a steady stream of threats and answers. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive game plan while efficiently handling threats with removal spells and disruptive cards. The key strategy is to utilize the synergy between Arclight Phoenix and cheap spells to close out games quickly and decisively.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing cards that exile threats, prevent opponents from attacking efficiently, and generate card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value from blinking permanents. Key cards like Runed Halo and Day of Judgment help deal with opposing threats, while Elspeth, Storm Slayer and Caretaker's Talent provide a way to generate tokens and card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy with a mix of utility lands and Plains.

This deck focuses on aggressively getting Arclight Phoenix into play, utilizing spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board while also drawing cards with Treasure Cruise and Consider. Picklock Prankster helps to enable the graveyard shenanigans that bring back Arclight Phoenix while cards like Sleight of Hand and Opt keep the deck running smoothly. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Proft's Eidetic Memory offers additional ways to close out games quickly. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast-paced and efficient game plan centered around Arclight Phoenix.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize low mana cost creatures and removal spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Go for the Throat, while also maintaining card advantage through Tinybones, the Pickpocket and Dark Confidant. The creatures in the deck, such as Cecil, Dark Knight and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor, are efficient threats that can put pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Smuggler's Copter and Mox Amber helps to provide additional card draw and mana acceleration.

The main idea of this deck is to play aggressively and quickly overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Lightning Strike, and Reckless Rage, along with efficient creatures like Heartfire Hero and Sunspine Lynx, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of land cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provides additional sources of damage, while cards like Monstrous Rage and Emberheart Challenger help to pump up the creatures for even more damage output.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures like Bishop of Wings, Llanowar Elves, and Righteous Valkyrie to attack early and often. Collected Company helps to quickly fill the board with creatures, while cards like Skyclave Apparition and Resplendent Angel provide removal and additional threats. The deck is focused on maintaining a strong presence on the battlefield, using lifegain and resilient creatures to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a powerful creature by stacking it with auras to make it difficult for opponents to deal with. The key strategy is to play low-cost auras like Ethereal Armor and All That Glitters onto creatures like Gladecover Scout and Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice to create a huge threat that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes protection spells like Sheltered by Ghosts and Kaya's Ghostform to keep the creature safe while attacking relentlessly. With a mix of power and resilience, this deck aims to win fast and decisively.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, and powerful threats like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to grind out value over time with card advantage from Castle Locthwain and Liliana of the Veil, while also utilizing Mutavault and Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber for additional utility and board presence. Finally, the inclusion of Blade of the Oni provides a powerful finisher and evasion option.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing spells and cheap creatures to quickly fill up the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, then bringing them back into play to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also focuses on drawing cards and filtering through the library efficiently to find the necessary pieces to achieve the combo. The inclusion of removal spells and versatile creatures like Picklock Prankster adds to the deck's flexibility and power in aggressive matchups. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and recurring threats while maintaining card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that allows for efficient removal of opponent's creatures and strong offensive plays. It also includes cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize for disruption, as well as Seasoned Hallowblade for protection. The deck aims to control the board and generate value through its combo pieces, while also having some flexibility with its land base to support its strategy.

This Aggro Red Deck Wins deck focuses on fast, aggressive creatures like Manifold Mouse, Heartfire Hero, and Emberheart Challenger to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also utilizes burn spells such as Lightning Strike and Burst Lightning to finish off opponents and control the board. The inclusion of Den of the Bugbear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provides additional threats and versatility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a continuous stream of creatures and burn spells to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice and graveyard mechanics to generate value and disrupt opponent's game plan. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using cards like Witch's Oven, the deck can trigger powerful effects while controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay. The deck can also generate card advantage with Trail of Crumbs and Dredger's Insight. Overall, the Golgari Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with synergistic plays and card advantage while maintaining board control.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing and stealing opponent's creatures to generate value and deal damage. The deck revolves around using Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar to create an engine that can repeatedly sacrifice and bring back creatures. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Mayhem Devil to control the board and punish opponents for each sacrifice. Ygra, Eater of All provides a powerful finisher, while cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute offer additional ways to disrupt opponent's strategies and gain advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing cards such as Burst Lightning, Lightning Strike, and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total and finish them off with creatures like Screaming Nemesis and Emberheart Challenger. The inclusion of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins allows for additional damage output, while Mutavault and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide versatility and resilience in combat.
